comments.quote: Q1. Should the copied link point to the local file?
comments.reply: Recorded A: copy a local file link. Added questions about the action, clipboard format, and Unsaved Drafts.

comments.quote: Q2. Should clicking the existing heading # copy its link?
comments.reply: Recorded B: keep the existing # navigation link and add a separate copy button.

comments.quote: Q3. Should the clipboard contain the full file URL?
comments.reply: Recorded A: copy the full local file URL as plain text.

comments.quote: Q4. Should copying remain available while there is an Unsaved Draft?
comments.reply: Recorded A: copy immediately without saving the Unsaved Draft.

comments.quote: Q5. Should the new copy button appear on hover and keyboard focus?
comments.reply: Recorded A: reveal heading controls on hover or keyboard focus.

comments.quote: Q6. Should every Markdown heading in Preview and Split get the copy button?
comments.reply: Recorded A: include all six heading levels in Preview and Split, including Question Cards. Added a question about deleted historical headings.

comments.quote: Q7. Should copy feedback stay beside the button?
comments.reply: Recorded A: inline success and actionable failure feedback, with screen reader announcements.

comments.quote: Q8. Is it acceptable for a link to break when its heading or file path changes?
comments.reply: Recorded A: preserve existing heading identifiers and accept broken links after renames or moves.

comments.quote: Q9. Should removed historical headings be excluded from copying?
comments.reply: Recorded A: omit copy buttons from removed historical headings.

comments.quote: Q10. Should heading controls stay visible when the device cannot hover?
comments.reply: Recorded A: keep controls visible without hover support. The interview is ready for your final check.
